instructions.name: accept_terms
docs: Freelancer signs the milestone's committed spec hash before funding.

instructions.name: approve_milestone
docs: Client-approved release of the full remaining milestone balance.

accounts.name: treasury_token_account
docs: Receives the protocol fee.

instructions.name: cancel_before_funding
docs: Cancels and closes a milestone that was never funded, cancelling the gig via CPI.

instructions.name: create_milestone
docs: Creates the next milestone for a gig, awaiting funding.

accounts.name: gig
docs: Ownership (Gig program), PDA derivation, and freshness are all checked by
the `seeds`/`seeds::program` constraint below, which re-derives the Gig
PDA from its own `id`/`bump` and rejects any account that doesn't match.

instructions.name: full_timeout_release
docs: Permissionless release of the remaining balance after `full_timeout` of client inaction.

accounts.name: treasury_token_account
docs: Receives the protocol fee.

instructions.name: fund_milestone
docs: Funds a milestone by transferring USDC from the client into the escrow vault.
On the gig's first funding, CPIs into the gig program to move it InProgress.

instructions.name: init_protocol_config
docs: One-time setup of the protocol config (first caller becomes admin).

accounts.name: treasury
docs: USDC token account that receives protocol fees.

instructions.name: partial_timeout_release
docs: Permissionless partial release (`partial_bps`) after `partial_timeout` of client inaction.

accounts.name: treasury_token_account
docs: Receives the protocol fee.

instructions.name: rate_freelancer
docs: Client submits the final 1-5 rating for a completed gig, CPI-attested by escrow.

instructions.name: refund_after_deadline
docs: Client reclaims a funded milestone with no delivery after deadline + grace.

instructions.name: set_protocol_admin
docs: Admin hands the config to a new admin (the DAO in Phase 2).

instructions.name: settle_reputation
docs: Permissionlessly notifies the Reputation Program once a gig's vault is
fully released. Callable exactly once per gig.

instructions.name: submit_delivery
docs: Records the freelancer's delivery submission.

instructions.name: update_protocol_config
docs: Admin updates protocol settings; every value is range-checked.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Fee destination; pass the current one to keep it.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not authorized to perform this action

errors.name: InvalidStatus
errors.msg: Account is not in the required status for this action

errors.name: InsufficientFunds
errors.msg: Vault does not hold sufficient funds

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: Token mint does not match the expected mint

errors.name: TimeoutNotReached
errors.msg: Timeout window has not yet elapsed

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: Milestone amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: GigNotFundable
errors.msg: Gig must be in Assigned or InProgress status to create/fund a milestone

errors.name: AmountBelowMinimum
errors.msg: Milestone amount is below the protocol minimum

errors.name: SpecHashMismatch
errors.msg: The spec hash does not match the milestone's committed spec

errors.name: TermsNotAccepted
errors.msg: The freelancer has not accepted this milestone's terms yet

errors.name: NoFreelancer
errors.msg: The gig has no assigned freelancer

errors.name: OutOfRange
errors.msg: A protocol setting is outside its allowed range

errors.name: GracePeriodActive
errors.msg: The no-delivery grace period has not passed yet

errors.name: InvalidTreasury
errors.msg: Treasury token account does not match the protocol config

fields.name: milestone_count
docs: Milestones created for this gig. Escrow-owned: this is payment-lifecycle
bookkeeping, not gig metadata, so it lives here rather than on the Gig account.

fields.name: active_milestone
docs: Milestones fully released so far.

fields.name: cancelled_milestones
docs: Milestones closed via `cancel_before_funding`. Counted separately rather
than decremented from `milestone_count`, because `milestone_count` also
allocates the next milestone's PDA index and must stay monotonic.
Settlement is reached when `active_milestone + cancelled_milestones`
covers every milestone ever created.

fields.name: reputation_synced
docs: Set once `settle_reputation` has notified the Reputation Program of this
gig's completion, so the CPI (and its earnings credit) can never fire twice.

fields.name: total_fees
docs: Protocol fees sent to the treasury across this gig's milestones.

fields.name: total_refunded
docs: Amount returned to the client across this gig's milestones.

fields.name: refunded_milestones
docs: Milestones closed via `refund_after_deadline`; they count as accounted
for in settlement, like cancelled ones.

fields.name: released
docs: Net amount paid out to the freelancer (after protocol fees).

fields.name: spec_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical milestone spec; zero = no spec.

fields.name: delivery_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the canonical delivery manifest.

fields.name: report_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the canonical verification report; zero = none.

fields.name: terms_accepted
docs: Freelancer signed `accept_terms` against `spec_hash`.

fields.name: submitted_slot
docs: Slot of `submit_delivery`; the sample audit seeds from `submitted_slot + 2`.

types.name: ProtocolConfig
docs: Singleton protocol settings, owned by escrow. The admin is an
upgrade-authority-held key in Phase 1; Phase 2 hands it to the DAO.
Milestones snapshot the timeout/bps terms when they are funded, so a
change only affects milestones funded afterwards.

fields.name: treasury
docs: USDC token account that receives protocol fees.

types.name: ProtocolSettings
docs: Settings passed to `init_protocol_config` / `update_protocol_config`.

fields.name: rating_sum
docs: Sum of all submitted ratings, kept alongside `rating_count` so the
average can be recomputed exactly instead of drifting through
repeated incremental updates.

fields.name: average_rating
docs: Average rating scaled by `RATING_SCALE` (e.g. 450 == 4.50 stars).

constants.name: ESCROW_AUTHORITY_SEED
docs: Seed for escrow's CPI-signer PDA, used to authorize calls into the gig program.

constants.name: PROTOCOL_CONFIG_SEED
docs: Seed for the singleton `ProtocolConfig` PDA.
